name: team_planning_undo_change
description: Undo a change, pin or clear in a scenario of a Team Planning plan, so the scenario resolves as if it had not been made. Give event_id, as team_planning_history lists it, or leave it out to undo your own latest change in the scenario that can still be undone. Refused when a later change to the same subject and facet replaced it (the refusal names that change: undo it first), when it is already undone, or unless the caller is an editor. In a plan scoped to chosen units, an undo is refused when the change it brings back is about someone, a unit or a position the plan no longer covers, unless it places them in. Nothing is deleted: the history keeps it, marked undone.
